description: Source code for the STMicroelectronics LPS28DFW pressure and temperature sensor driver, including initialization, data fetching, and interrupt handling.

methods.name: lps28dfw_mode_set_odr_raw
methods.description: Sets the output data rate (ODR) of the sensor with raw configuration.

methods.name: lps28dfw_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches a sample of pressure and temperature data from the sensor.

methods.name: lps28dfw_handle_interrupt
methods.description: Handles the data ready interrupt, reads status, and calls registered handler.

methods.name: lps28dfw_enable_int
methods.description: Enables or disables the interrupt pin for data ready signals.

methods.name: lps28dfw_trigger_set
methods.description: Sets external trigger for data ready event and registers handler.

methods.name: st_lps28dfw_init
methods.description: Initializes the LPS28DFW sensor device, including ID check, reset, configuration, and optional trigger setup.
